Definition: neuter plural of a presumed compound from G1722 and G2537; innovatives, i.e. (specially) renewal (of religious services after the Antiochian interruption):--dedication.
BiblicalUsage: The feast of the dedication in John 10:22 — the winter feast at Jerusalem remembering the cleansing of the temple — is the one place this word stands, and it is where Jesus walks in Solomon's porch and the Jews gather around Him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the feast that remembered a cleansed temple is the right setting for Jesus to say He and the Father are one, because He is the true temple, cleansed and dedicated once for all.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
